title: Technical Co-Lead · CSI-CATT
description: Elected Technical Co-Lead of CSI-CATT DMCE for 2026-27, by a vote of the chapter. I now run the technical side of the college's Computer Society, including workshops, hackathons, and dev projects. I joined as a contributor and worked my way up to leading the team.

title: Shipped to 500+ Users · SIMS
description: Most portfolio projects never leave localhost. SIMS runs on a college domain with 500+ registered students. I built it during my internship under the HOD and owned the entire frontend. Watching real people use something you made is a great feeling.

title: Internship · Full Dev Team
description: Part of the development team behind the Student Information Management System, a real deployment serving a college. We built it from scratch during a structured internship program, under the direct mentorship of the Head of Department.

title: Internship Certificate · DMCE
description: The official internship completion certificate from Datta Meghe College of Engineering, recognizing my full-stack work on the SIMS platform.

title: Letter of Appreciation
description: Received an official Letter of Appreciation from the institution for my contribution during the internship, recognizing the quality and impact of the work I delivered.

title: Official Certificate · TT Doubles
description: The official certificate for finishing 2nd in Table Tennis Doubles at DMCE Milestone 2025. Turns out the focus and strategy that help in code work just as well at the table.

title: Top 8 Finalist · Code-A-Thon 2.0
description: Singularity placed Top 8 out of 100+ entries at Code-A-Thon 2.0. We built it over 1.5 months, not a weekend sprint, pulling live data from NASA, SpaceX, and ISRO into one mission control. It covers orbital mechanics, 3D globe rendering, AI integration, and live ISS tracking.

title: The Team Behind Singularity
description: Code-A-Thon 2.0 was a team effort. Each of us owned a critical piece of Singularity, from backend architecture to 3D rendering, and it all came together through late nights and a lot of iteration.

title: 2nd Place · Table Tennis Doubles
description: Teamed up with a senior for the DMCE Milestone 2025 Table Tennis Doubles tournament and fought our way to the final, finishing 2nd. Proof that competitive drive isn't limited to a keyboard.
